steps.title: LOGIN
steps.response: XXX (N) LOGGED IN AT HR'MN MMDDYY. XXX represents the user initials; N is the terminal location number; HR and MN is the time the user entered the system in hours and minutes; and MMDDYY is the month, day, and year. This login allows user XXX to access any of the active programs on the SPADS system.

steps.title: PROGRAM ENTRY
prompt: THE FOLLOWING IS A LIST OF CURRENT APPLICATIONS
PLEASE INDICATE YOUR APPLICATION/PROJECT BY SELECTING THE APPROPRIATE KEY

input.description: Enter MAIL to select the MAIL LOG program.

steps.title: DATA BASE SUBFILE SELECTION
prompt: DO YOU WISH TO WORK WITH THE DIR/REPORT DATA --- ENTER DIR

input.description: One of three main data base subfiles must be designated before one of the four modes of operation can be selected. To leave the program, enter QUIT at the mode selection, then QU here.

steps.title: MODE SELECTION
prompt: PLEASE CHOSE ONE OF THE FOLLOWING

input.description: Enter the key for the desired mode. A user without clearance for a mode sees: SORRY, YOU ARE NOT VALIDATED TO USE THIS MODE. IF IT IS NECESSARY, PLEASE CONTACT SYSTEM OPERATOR AT EXT. 2621.

steps.title: Step #1
prompt: WELCOME TO THE DRAW-EO FILE INPUT ROUTINE
PLEASE INPUT INFORMATION BETWEEN EXCLAMATION MARKS AND LEFT
IS THIS A DRAWING OR AN E.O. (DRAW OR EO)

steps.title: Step #2
steps.response: If legal entry, the entry is displayed on terminal. If not legal, step is repeated. This is done for all entries to follow. NOTE: User must skip a space before entering data.

input.description: Enter vehicle number XXXA up to two numbers, where XXX represents the numbers. The 'A' represents the letter 'S' which stands for all subsequent vehicle numbers after XXX.

steps.title: Step #7
prompt: E SECT      UPPER B     LOWER B     ALCYONE IA    ALCYONE IIA
G SECT      UPPER C     LOWER C     ALGOL IIA     ALGOL IIIA
EG SECT     UPPER D     LOWER D     ANTARES IIA   ANTARES IIIA
BASE A      UPPER F     LOWER F     ALTAIR IIIA   CASTOR IIA

input.description: Enter the revision of sheet #1; NC if none.
Enter number XX E.O.'s against sheet #1; up to maximum of 10 E.O. numbers may be referenced.

steps.title: Step #12
prompt: ENTER ANY FURTHER AVAILABLE DATA FOR EACH E.O.
steps.response: See Steps #20 thru #25. Repeat Steps #11 and #12 XX number of times. Go to #13.

branches.when: More referenced E.O.'s to enter (XX times in all)

steps.title: Step #13
steps.response: If X number of sheets = 1, go to #19. If X number of sheet is more than 1, go to #14.

input.description: Enter the sheet number as in the example.
Enter the sheet revision; NC if none.
Enter number XX E.O.'s against sheet entered in Step #14; up to maximum of 10 E.O. numbers may be referenced.

steps.title: Step #18
prompt: ENTER ANY FURTHER AVAILABLE DATA FOR EACH E.O.
steps.response: See Steps #20 thru #25. Repeat Steps #17 and #18 XX number of times. Go to #19.

branches.when: More referenced E.O.'s to enter (XX times in all)

steps.title: Step #19
steps.response: Entire drawing record along with referenced E.O.'s are displayed on the terminal. Go to #34.

steps.title: Step #20
steps.response: If legal entry, the entry is displayed on terminal. If not legal, step is repeated. This is done for all entries to follow. NOTE: User must skip a space before entering data.

input.description: Enter vehicle number XXXA up to two numbers, where XXX represents the numbers. The 'A' represents the letter 'S' which stands for all subsequent vehicle numbers after XXX.

steps.title: Step #26
prompt: HOW MANY DRAWINGS DOES THIS E.O. REFERENCE

input.description: Enter number XX; up to maximum of 99.

steps.title: Step #28
prompt: HOW MANY SHEETS OF THIS DRAWING ARE REFERENCED BY THIS E.O.

input.description: Enter number of sheets NN (Maximum of 99).

steps.title: Step #29

input.description: Enter the sheet number as in the example.

steps.response: Repeat this step NN number of times. Repeat Steps #27 thru #29 XX number of times.

branches.when: More sheets of this drawing (NN times in all)

steps.title: Step #30
steps.response: If number of E.O.'s on a sheet is: Less than four, go to #34. Five, go to #32. More than five, go to #33.

steps.title: Step #31
steps.response: A warning message is displayed on the terminal prior to displaying the entire engineering order record. See output section 5.3.1. Go to #34.

steps.title: Step #32
steps.response: An attention message is displayed on the terminal prior to displaying the entire engineering order record. See output section 5.3.1. Go to #34.

steps.title: Step #33
steps.response: An important revision action due message is displayed on the terminal prior to displaying the entire engineering order record. See output section 5.3.1. Go to #34.

steps.title: Step #34
prompt: IS THERE FURTHER INFORMATION TO BE INPUT (YES OR NO)

steps.title: Step #1
prompt: DO YOU WISH THE E.O. OR THE DRAWING FILE (EO OR DRAW)

steps.title: Step #2
prompt: PLEASE INPUT THE SPO EO NUMBER OF THE RECORD TO BE REVISED

steps.title: Step #3
prompt: PLEASE INPUT THE SPO DRAWING NUMBER OF THE RECORD TO BE REVISED

input.description: Enter number after skipping one space; go to #4.

steps.title: Step #4
steps.response: Entire record displayed on terminal when found.

steps.title: Step #5
prompt: IS THIS THE CORRECT RECORD TO BE REVISED OR DELETED (YES OR NO)
steps.response: If No, continue search for number. When found repeat Step #4. If not found, exit REVISE mode.

branches.when: NO, not found: exit REVISE mode

steps.title: Step #6
prompt: IS THIS RECORD TO BE REVISED OR DELETED (REV OR DEL)
steps.response: If DEL, record DELETED; exit REVISE mode.

branches.when: DEL: record deleted, exit REVISE mode

steps.title: Step #7
prompt: HOW MANY ITEMS DO YOU WISH TO REVISE (MAX OF 6)

steps.title: Step #8
prompt: INPUT THE ITEM NUMBER THAT YOU WISH TO REVISE

steps.title: Step #9
steps.response: Repeat X number of times. Branch to data item N to be revised as shown in Input mode (4.3.1.2 Steps #20 thru #25). Go to #24.

branches.when: Branch to data item N as shown in Input mode (4.3.1.2 Steps #20 thru #25)

steps.title: Step #10
prompt: HOW MANY ITEMS DO YOU WISH TO REVISE (MAX OF 9)

steps.title: Step #11
prompt: INPUT ITEM NUMBER THAT YOU WISH TO REVISE

steps.title: Step #12
prompt: IS THIS A CORRECTION OF SHEET ITEM: ENTER YES
OR IS THIS A NEW SHEET ENTRY FOR A DRAWING: ENTER NEW

steps.title: Step #13
prompt: IS THIS A REVISION ENTRY FOR A NEW DRAWING SHEET (YES OR NO)

input.description: Note: A No answer indicates a revision item correction. A Yes answer will delete all E.O.'s for this sheet. Enter response; go to #14.

steps.title: Step #14
steps.response: Repeat Step #11 X number of times. Branch to data item N to be revised. See INPUT mode (4.3.1.2 Step #2 thru #8).

branches.when: Branch to data item N to be revised (INPUT mode 4.3.1.2 Step #2 thru #8)
Repeat Step #11 X number of times

steps.title: Step #17
prompt: WHAT SHEET IS TO BE REVISED.

steps.title: Step #18
prompt: SHEET REVISION: IF NONE, ENTER NC

steps.title: Step #19
prompt: WHAT SHEET NUMBER DO YOU WISH TO REVISE A REFERENCED E.O.

steps.title: Step #20
prompt: HOW MANY DO YOU WISH TO REVISE
steps.response: All E.O.'s will be displayed with a counter to number each up to 10.

steps.title: Step #21
prompt: ENTER THE REFERENCED E.O. NUMBER TO BE REVISED

input.description: Enter EO number. This number will replace the NNth EO listed in Step #20.

steps.title: Step #23
steps.response: Repeat steps #21 and #22 XX number of times as indicated in Step #20. Go to #24.

branches.when: More E.O.'s to revise (XX times in all)

steps.title: Step #24
steps.response: Entire record displayed on terminal.

steps.title: Step #1
prompt: YOU ARE VALIDATED TO SEARCH DATA IN THE DRAWING FILE. THE
FOLLOWING SEARCH MODES ARE AVAILABLE FOR YOUR USE

steps.title: Step #2
steps.response: If Quit, go to #60. No user reponse.

steps.title: Step #3
prompt: DO YOU DESIRE THE OPTIONAL BRIEF OUTPUT.
RECOMMENDED FOR ALL AND ACTION DUE SEARCHES (YES OR NO)

input.description: Enter Option: Brief gives faster search response. See sample outputs Figures 41 and 42.

steps.title: Step #5
prompt: HOW MANY WORDS DO YOU WISH TO MATCH (MAX OF 4)

input.description: Enter word AAAA; up to 10 characters.

steps.title: Step #7
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DRAWINGS CONTAINING THE WORD AAAA
steps.response: As each title is found containing the desired word, the title is displayed on the terminal. Following the last title is displayed the message. Where XXX represents the number of drawings found and AAAA is the desired word entered.

steps.title: Step #8
steps.response: Steps #6 and #7 are repeated X number of times from Step #5 unless zero (0) drawings are found. If no drawings are found, go to #11.

branches.when: More words to match (X times in all)

steps.title: Step #9
steps.response: For all drawings found, drawing data is displayed after the last word is searched. See figure 14.

steps.title: Step #10
prompt: IF YOU WISH TO CONTINUE, DEPRESS THE RETURN KEY

input.description: When Return key is used, go to #1.

steps.title: Step #11
prompt: DO YOU WISH TO TRY THE TITLE SEARCH AGAIN (YES OR NO)

steps.title: Step #12
prompt: WHICH PRINT ALL OPTION DO YOU WISH:

steps.title: Step #13
prompt: THIS IS THE PRINT ALL ROUTINE
ALL DRAWINGS STORED IN THE DRAW FILE WILL BE SPOOLED AND A TOTAL
COUNT OF THE DRAWINGS WILL BE GIVEN

steps.title: Step #14
steps.response: Drawing data is displayed on the terminal for each drawing found along with referenced E.O.'s. See Figure 41.

steps.title: Step #15
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DRAWINGS IN THE DRAW FILE
steps.response: Where XXX represents the number of drawings found. Go to #19.

steps.title: Step #16
prompt: THIS IS THE PRINT ALL ROUTINE
ALL ENGINEERING ORDERS STORED IN THE EO FILE WILL BE SPOOLED AND
A TOTAL COUNT OF THE DRAWINGS WILL BE GIVEN

steps.title: Step #17
steps.response: Engineering order data is displayed on the terminal for each EO found. See Figure 42.

steps.title: Step #18
prompt: THERE ARE XXX E.O.'s IN THE EO SUBFILE
steps.response: Where XXX represents the number of engineering orders found. Go to #18.

steps.title: Step #19
steps.response: Output file is automatically spooled to the high speed printer; exit the SEARCH mode.

steps.title: Step #20
prompt: THIS IS THE REVISION ACTION DUE SEARCH ROUTINE
ALL DRAWINGS WITH FIVE (5) OR MORE E.O.'s ARE FOUND AND SPOOLED

steps.title: Step #21
steps.response: Drawing data is displayed on the terminal for each drawing sheet found. See Figure 41.

steps.title: Step #22
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DRAWINGS WITH A TOTAL OF NNN SHEET(S) IN THE
DRAWING SUBFILE WHICH MUST BE REVISED
steps.response: Where XXX represents the number of drawings found and NNN represents the number sheets found.

steps.title: Step #23
steps.response: If no drawings are found, go to #24. If drawings are found, output file is automatically spooled to the high speed printer; exit the SEARCH mode.

branches.when: Drawings found: spooled, exit SEARCH mode

steps.title: Step #24
steps.response: Go to #10.

steps.title: Step #25
prompt: WHAT IS THE DESIRED DRAWING NUMBER

steps.title: Step #26a / #26b
prompt: THERE IS NO DRAWING WITH NUMBER NNNN IN THE DRAWING FILE
steps.response: #26a: Drawing data is displayed on the terminal along with referenced E.O.'s. See Figure 41. #26b: If not found, the message is displayed, where NNNN represents the drawing number entered for the search.

steps.title: Step #27
steps.response: Go to #10.

steps.title: Step #28
prompt: WHAT IS THE DATE THAT YOU WANT

input.description: Enter date; month, day, and year after skipping one space. Entering 00 for the day or month retrieves an entire month's or year's worth of data.

steps.title: Step #29
steps.response: Drawing data is displayed on the terminal for each drawing found along with referenced E.O.'s. See Figure 41.

steps.title: Step #30
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DRAWINGS WITH A DATE OF MM-DD-YY
steps.response: Where XXX represents the number of drawings found and MMDDYY represents the date entered for the search.

steps.title: Step #31
steps.response: Go to #10.

input.description: Enter system AAAA; up to 12 characters.

steps.title: Step #33
steps.response: Drawing data is displayed on the terminal for each drawing found along with referenced E.O.'s. See Figure 41.

steps.title: Step #34
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DRAWINGS WITH A SYSTEM OF AAAA
steps.response: Where XXX represents the number of drawings found and AAAA represents the system entered for the search.

steps.title: Step #35
steps.response: Go to #10.

steps.title: Step #36
prompt: WHAT IS THE DESIRED VEHICLE NUMBER

steps.title: Step #37
prompt: WHAT IS THE FIRST VALID VEHICLE NUMBER

input.description: Enter number. If information on a specific vehicle is desired, enter the same vehicle as in Step #36. Default is zero (0).

steps.title: Step #38
prompt: WHAT IS THE LAST VALID VEHICLE NUMBER

input.description: Enter number. If information on a specific vehicle is desired, enter the same vehicle as in Step #36.

steps.title: Step #39
prompt: DO YOU WISH A LIST OF ALL E.O.'S FOR A SPECIFIC VEHICLE:
OR A LIST OF DRAWINGS RELATED TO SPECIFIC VEHICLE:

steps.title: Step #40
steps.response: Drawing data is displayed on the terminal for each drawing found along with referenced E.O.'s. See Figure 41.

steps.title: Step #41
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DRAWINGS RELATING TO VEHICLE NNN
steps.response: Where XXX represents the number of drawings found and NNN represents the vehicle number entered for the search.

steps.title: Step #42
steps.response: Go to #10.

steps.title: Step #43
steps.response: Engineering order data is displayed on the terminal for each EO found. See Figure 43.

steps.title: Step #44
prompt: THERE ARE XXX E.O.'S RELATED TO VEHICLE NNN
steps.response: Where XXX represents the number of engineering orders found and NNN represents the vehicle number entered for the search.

steps.title: Step #45
steps.response: Go to #10.

steps.title: Step #46
prompt: E SECT      UPPER B     LOWER B     ALCYONE IA    ALCYONE IIA
G SECT      UPPER C     LOWER C     ALGOL IIA     ALGOL IIIA
EG SECT     UPPER D     LOWER D     ANTARES IIA   ANTARES IIIA
BASE A      UPPER F     LOWER F     ALTAIR IIIA   CASTOR IIA

input.description: Enter section AAAA; up to 12 characters.

steps.title: Step #47
steps.response: Drawing data is displayed on the terminal for each drawing found along with referenced E.O.'s. See Figure 41.

steps.title: Step #48
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DRAWINGS RELATED TO SECTION AAAA
steps.response: Where XXX represents the number of drawings found and AAA represents the section entered for the search.

steps.title: Step #49
steps.response: Go to #10.

steps.title: Step #50
prompt: WHAT IS THE DESIRED VENDOR CODE

steps.title: Step #51
steps.response: Drawing data is displayed on the terminal for each drawing found along with referenced E.O.'s. See Figure 41.

steps.title: Step #52
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DRAWINGS WITH THE SPECIFIED VENDOR CODE AAA
steps.response: Where XXX represents the number of drawings found and AAA represents the vendor code entered for the search.

steps.title: Step #53
steps.response: Go to #10.

steps.title: Step #54
prompt: WHAT IS THE DESIRED E.O. NUMBER

steps.title: Step #55
prompt: DO YOU DESIRE THE E.O. FILE SEARCH (EO)
OR ALL DRAWINGS USING THIS E.O. (DR)

steps.title: Step #56a / #56b
prompt: THERE IS NO E.O. NNNNNN IN THE EO SUBFILE
steps.response: #56a: Engineering order data is displayed on the terminal when EO number is found. See figure 42. #56b: If not found, the message is displayed, where NNNNNN represents the engineering order number entered for the search.

steps.title: Step #57
steps.response: Go to #10.

steps.title: Step #58
prompt: THERE ARE XXX DRAWINGS WITH A TOTAL OF NNN SHEET(S) IN THE DRAWING
steps.response: Where XXX represents the number of drawings found, NNN represents the number of sheets found, and NNNNNN represents the engineering order number entered for the search.

steps.title: Step #59
steps.response: Go to #10.

steps.title: Step #60
prompt: DO YOU WANT A HARD COPY OF THE INFORMATION FOUND

input.description: If Yes, output spooled to printer. See section 5.3.2 for outputs.

steps.title: Step #61
steps.response: Exit SEARCH mode.

steps.title: Step #1
prompt: DO YOU WISH TO ARCHIVE DRAWINGS OR E.O.'s (DR OR EO)

steps.title: Step #2
prompt: WELCOME TO THE DRAWING FILE ARCHIVE ROUTINE.
HOW MANY DRAWINGS DO YOU WISH TO ARCHIVE

steps.title: Step #3
prompt: WHAT IS THE DRAWING NUMBER OF THE DRAWING YOU WISH TO ARCHIVE

steps.title: Step #4
steps.response: Pause for system housekeeping to be completed. Repeat Step #3 XX number of times. Go to #7.

branches.when: More drawings to archive (XX times in all)

steps.title: Step #5
prompt: PLEASE STAND BY. SYSTEM IS NOW ARCHIVING UNREFERENCED E.O.'S
steps.response: No user response required.

steps.title: Step #6
steps.response: As each E.O. is archived the message is displayed on the terminal, where NNNNNN represents the engineering order number.

steps.title: Step #7
steps.response: Exit ARCHIVE mode when done. The user is automatically returned to the program mode selection level.
